description: Semantic search over active Polish public tenders (przetargi) by meaning, with optional filters. Ranks by relevance (hybrid vector + keyword). Returns paginated tender cards, each with a public URL. Tenders without an AI summary yet are included: their card has has_summary=false and no teaser, get_tender returns their notice data, and a signed-in user on a trial or paid plan can order the summary in Przetargowy Janusz. `mode` is 'semantic', or 'lexical' when the embedding service is temporarily unavailable; `unapplied_filters` then lists the filters it could not apply exactly.

cpv.description: Restrict to tenders whose CPV includes this code

deadline_before.description: ISO date; only tenders with submission deadline before it

query.description: Natural-language query, e.g. 'budowa hali sportowej z basenem'

region.description: Voivodeship (województwo): slug or name from list_facets, e.g. 'slaskie' or 'śląskie'

name: search_tenders
title: Szukaj przetargów
